evidence.name: Screen field: Checkbox look
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Checkbox look" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Checkbox look
sections.description: Appearance of the selection checkbox — shape (square or circle), checked color, unchecked color, and padding. Use your theme's accent for the checked color so a tap reads clearly as selected, matching the selected-item look. Circle suits pick-one (radio style), square suits multi-select. Only appears when the layout includes a checkbox or on grids.
